title: Graham conjecture on small sets in abelian groups
summary: A famous conjecture of Graham asserts that every set $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_p \setminus \{0\}$ can be ordered so that all partial sums are distinct. Although this conjecture was recently proved for sufficiently large primes by Pham and Sauermann in~\cite{PM} (combined with earlier results of \cite{BBKMM}), it remains open for general abelian groups, even in the cyclic case $\mathbb{Z}_k$. In this paper, using a recursive approach, we investigate the sequenceability of subsets $A$ in generic abelian groups for small values of $|A|$.
